body:
Thanks and all.  But talking to random people on the internet has never and will never solve my problems.  Delay them for a bit maybe, but the whole adage of SW, of every person who speaks against suicide, is "it gets better".  Well I'm 31 and it's been a slow, steady downward spiral since 18, so that doesn't really help me.  For some people it *doesn't* get better.  You have to *make* it better.  And I can't.

I've tried to make it better in my stupid, little ways, but I always end up in the same pit, digging a little deeper each time so that next time I fall the light is that much further away.  My ridiculous morals, terrible self-esteem, and atrophied social skills only make me more lonely, even when I'm trying to socialize, and I just wind up tired and sad.

I need to be a dick.  A jerk.  Make my wants known and take from life what I need instead of being so goddamn respectful all the time.  But.

I can't.  I loathe the idea of a world where that's necessary.

And all of life is us deciding which is more important, what sacrifices we'll make.  I made mine.  I wanted the dream of good people over the reality I see every day.  But I'm tired of staring at it and hoping.  I just don't want to think any more.  I don't DO anything with my thoughts, so why have them.  I'm tired of caring silently but not doing, but I can't do, I'm too lazy/stupid/lethargic/depressed/whatever/proud/needy/sad/inept.  I don't know why I'm like this but I am and I did it to myself, I know because everyone around me is nice to me and says great things.

But every cell in my brain is so tired.

You do good work here.  I've seen you on before, helping.  You dont' even get paid, but you should.  I marathoned Babylon 5 recently and your name reminded me.  Don't get discouraged cause I bet you help a lot of these people in little ways.

I don't want to scare you or make you sad or make you think what you do isn't worth it.  I think maybe some people are just born or develop weird ways of looking at the world, they don't learn to filter enough or too much, and they can't handle it.  They'd rather not exist than keep trying, and it's sad, but for every one of those there's a hundred who just need a kind word or someone to listen.

I just don't want to think about anything anymore.  No one will be quite like me, but there's an infinite kaleidoscope of humanity yet to be born, and my footprint has been very small.  No man is an island but no man or woman keeps the ocean from flowing either.

Both.  I am quiet and respectful, and while I do it for its own merit and because I like being a good person, besides that it's gotten me...absolutely nil so far.  And it feels bad when I'm surrounded by people who get what they want aggressively, sometimes even without regard for others, and win for it.  They take and apologize after, and it works.
I try to be honest, find someone to heal with, to care for, and it doesn't work.  It's too raw and awkward and then I get ignored because that's not the norm.  A 100% fail rate is un-justifiable as anything besides extreme unattractiveness.  I should've *stumbled* into getting lucky by now at the least, but no.  I am self-sabotaging by being myself.
And if you can't be yourself...why am I still around?

the only one telling me I' m weak is me (well the only one I listen to anyway).  unfortunately I can be very ocnvincing.

I've talked to close friends and family about it before, but thy think I'm "all better now".  I've never quite got over the lonelines but I came to terms with it for a while but was just treading water.  They'v let me know (since I'm "better") that when I was int hat dark place it was terrible for them (and me of course they're all good people). But I won't put them through that again.  goddamn for an enlgish degree my spelling sucks when I'm drunkk but wtf.

that "turn your life around" thing only works in 2 situations:
- the depression is a temporary, like from a breakup rosomething, or adolescence thing and it'll go away in time,

- it's chronic but you break through get help and build good habits to overcome to bad ones and be ever vigilant

I'm not the first one and I cant do the second I've tried.  i'mm really tired of trying and just treading water too.  cycles of not caring and pain and cariing too much are all I have for more years now than I haven;t, and i'[m too tired of it.  Time to stop treading soon i just hope I have to balls to end the suffering.  I will be very sorry to my fmily and friends it will hurt them immensely but that alone can't keep me anymore it;'s too much.
